page.title: Voice Assistant
page.descPre: Speech to text, with two engines:
page.descOffline: (local Whisper model, speech never leaves your machine, no internet needed, the model is bundled and needs no download). Recognized text is filled into the text box automatically and can be edited freely.
page.tipMid: (draggable) in the bottom-right corner of any page to expand the menu, where you can toggle the "Voice Assistant" popup or jump to other pages. You can also press
page.tipPost: to bring up the voice assistant overlay directly.

input.placeholder: Click the mic to start voice input; recognized text is filled in here and can be edited…
input.webEngineTip: Use the browser's native speech recognition for real-time continuous transcription
input.localEngineTip: Run the Whisper model locally; speech never leaves your machine, works offline
input.fallbackHint: Online recognition seems unavailable (domestic networks often cannot reach Chrome's recognition service). One click to switch:
input.webUnsupported: This browser does not support online speech recognition (requires Chrome / Edge / Safari).
input.clickSwitchLocal: Click here to switch to offline recognition
input.recordUnsupported: This browser does not support recording (needs a modern browser with MediaRecorder).
input.recordingHint: Recording… click "Stop and recognize" to finish

micPermission: Microphone permission denied. Please allow this page to use the microphone in the browser address bar, then retry.

errors.noSpeech: No speech detected, please move closer to the microphone and try again
errors.network: Online speech service connection failed (possibly a network issue); switching to "offline recognition" is recommended
errors.startFailed: Cannot start online speech recognition, please refresh the page and retry
errors.noResponse: Online recognition has not responded for a long time (usually the network cannot reach the recognition service); switching to "offline recognition" is recommended

sendToAgentTip: Send the current text to the AI Agent
